purpose: Reusable readiness gateway and conditional Unit 0 refresher architecture for Khaemenes courses.
principles: A diagnostic guides support; it does not label or punish a learner.
Course completion and next-course readiness are separate records.
A high overall score must not hide a critical prerequisite gap.
Students who are ready enter Official Unit 1 without added workload.
Students who need reinforcement receive a targeted Unit 0 and re-enter the same official curriculum after mastery.
NAIB receives strand-level evidence, not only a total score.

assessment_contract.feedback: Do not reveal correct answers before submission.

style.heading: Cinzel
style.body: Brandon Grotesque or academy fallback stack

unit_0_contract.adaptive_behavior: Strong prerequisite strands may use confirmation challenges while weak strands receive full refresher instruction.

naib_profile_contract.rule: Never erase or downgrade a completed-course record because of a later readiness diagnostic.
